sampling.sampling_note: Non-crypto metadata exclusions added before expanded history analysis; no return-based selection.
sampling.method: SHA256(seed + symbol), active USDT spot universe as observed today; no current return or volume ranking

event.definition: A 4h candle closes at least 20% above its own open, with no such candle in the preceding 48h. This is an operational first strong candle, not necessarily the start of every gradual rally.

model.type: L2 regularized logistic ranking; scores are not calibrated probabilities
model.preprocessing: Training-only median/IQR, clip standardized inputs to [-5,5]; balanced positive and negative training loss

matched_controls.method: Same decision timestamp, non-event next 24h, closest historical log 24h quote volume and ATR/close. No future current market cap or current supply is inserted.
matched_controls.fundamentals_limitation: Historical then-published market cap/supply are unavailable across the expanded sample; exclude them from predictive model and matching, keep original seven descriptive estimates separate.

constraints: Features end at candle close; positive event opens 4 to 24 hours AFTER that close.
Target and secondary outcomes use future data only as labels, never as inputs.
All evaluation signals require full 48h future observations; current rankings require no outcome labels.
A 72h training boundary embargo separates training labels from the October holdout.
User-selected seven examples are excluded from model fitting and primary holdout performance.
Universe contains currently active pairs; delisted-pair survivorship is an explicit limitation.
Do not optimize parameters on October holdout, and do not claim profitability from high-price excursions.
